title: The OSI Model and Encapsulation

header.html: 1.1 Explain concepts related to the Open Systems Interconnection (OSI) reference model: layer 1 physical, layer 2 data link, layer 3 network, layer 4 transport, layer 5 session, layer 6 presentation, layer 7 application
the official CompTIA Network+ N10-009 exam objectives, version 4.0

html:
1The seven layers

The OSI model is a reference model that splits network communication into seven layers. Each layer serves the layer above and uses the layer below.

# Layer Job Data unit Examples
7 Application Network services for applications Data HTTP, HTTPS, DNS, SMTP, SSH
6 Presentation Format, encrypt, compress data Data TLS (often placed here), JPEG, encoding
5 Session Open, manage and close conversations Data NetBIOS sessions, RPC
4 Transport End-to-end delivery, ports, reliability Segment (TCP) / datagram (UDP) TCP, UDP
3 Network Logical addressing and routing Packet IP, ICMP, routers
2 Data link Local delivery with MAC addresses, error detection Frame Ethernet, switches, MAC
1 Physical Bits on the medium (signals, cables, radio) Bits Cables, hubs, repeaters, NICs
Exam tip

. Memory aid, top to bottom: "All People Seem To Need Data Processing"; bottom to top: "Please Do Not Throw Sausage Pizza Away". Know the data unit at each layer: bits, frames, packets, segments.

2Encapsulation

Data moves down the stack at the sender, each layer adding a header (encapsulation), and up the stack at the receiver, each layer removing its header (de-encapsulation).

Step What is added
Transport Port numbers (source and destination)
Network IP addresses
Data link MAC addresses and a trailer with a frame check sequence

3Which layer is the problem?

Device or feature Layer
Hub, repeater, cable, NIC signaling 1
Switch, bridge, MAC addresses, VLAN tag 2
Router, IP address, ICMP 3
TCP, UDP, port numbers, stateful firewall (tracks sessions) 4
Proxy, web application firewall, HTTP, DNS 7
Exam tip

. A "layer 3 switch" routes (layer 3) as well as switches (layer 2). A layer 4 load balancer decides by IP and port; a layer 7 load balancer decides by URL or content.

Exam tip

. Switches work at layer 2 and routers at layer 3; when a scenario names an IP address, think layer 3; a MAC address, think layer 2.

4Exam Q&A

4.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1A technician finds a duplicate MAC address on a switch. At which OSI layer is the problem?

  • ALayer 2, the data link layer
  • BLayer 1, the physical layer
  • CLayer 3, the network layer
  • DLayer 4, the transport layer
Show the answer

Answer: A. MAC addresses operate at the data link layer.

S2A router forwards a packet using the destination IP address. Which layer does this describe?

  • ALayer 3, the network layer
  • BLayer 2, the data link layer
  • CLayer 4, the transport layer
  • DLayer 7, the application layer
Show the answer

Answer: A. Routing uses logical IP addresses at layer 3.

S3Which data unit is used at the transport layer for TCP?

  • AFrame
  • BPacket
  • CSegment
  • DBit
Show the answer

Answer: C. TCP data units are segments (UDP uses datagrams).

S4A cable has a broken wire and the link is down. Which layer does the fault belong to?

  • ALayer 2, the data link layer
  • BLayer 4, the transport layer
  • CLayer 1, the physical layer
  • DLayer 5, the session layer
Show the answer

Answer: C. Cables and signaling are layer 1.

S5A load balancer chooses a server using the requested URL. At which layer does it work?

  • ALayer 3, the network layer
  • BLayer 7, the application layer
  • CLayer 4, the transport layer
  • DLayer 5, the session layer
Show the answer

Answer: B. Choosing by URL or content is layer 7 behavior.

4.2 Recall questions

R1How many layers does the OSI model have?

Show the answer

Seven.

R2Which layer uses MAC addresses?

Show the answer

Layer 2, the data link layer.

R3Which layer provides end-to-end delivery and ports?

Show the answer

Layer 4, the transport layer.

R4What is the data unit at layer 3?

Show the answer

A packet.

R5What is the data unit at layer 2?

Show the answer

A frame.

R6What is encapsulation?

Show the answer

Each layer adds its header as data moves down the stack at the sender.

5Quick Reference Card

Layer Name Data unit Typical items
7 Application Data HTTP, DNS, proxy
6 Presentation Data encryption, formats
5 Session Data session control
4 Transport Segment TCP, UDP, ports
3 Network Packet IP, router
2 Data link Frame MAC, switch
1 Physical Bits cables, hubs
